inputs.materiales: The six task artefacts listed in built_from, the live wosy store at /Users/you/work/umbrella/.devwork/connectors/brain.db with 483 rows, and the brain CLI at /Users/you/.local/bin/brain version 0.1.0-p1.

brief.de_que_trata: Deciding what to keep from two generations of a working-but-partial memory system, and writing that decision down with its evidence. wosy is the vehicle and second-brain v2's operation set is the specification.
brief.porque: The system works and the cost of keeping it working is the defect. Measured: 873 handoff-shaped files with 1 countersignature, 80.8% read within a median of 1.4 hours, and no measurable effect on the receiver's reconstruction cost. The protocol ends one step too early.
brief.para_que: One store per project with an agnostic read and write path, one append-only logbook, and a briefing assembled from that logbook rather than composed at the moment of lowest fidelity.
brief.en_que_nos_quedamos: P00 closed on 2026-09-24 by adoption rather than by code review. The baseline probe passed on 2026-09-24 and both its controls went red in the same block, so the instrument discriminates. The store holds 483 rows, scores 6 of 9 on the fact battery and 4 of 15 on the use battery, and owes the three D-7 schemas.
brief.que_sigue: Write the three D-7 schemas under /Users/you/.devwork/_schema/ and gate each one with check-jsonschema against a real example and a deliberately broken one in the same block. Then decide the slice unit — concept, field, or merchant/ticket — against ask shapes B, C and F.

evidence.claim: The baseline probe passed and both controls went red in the same block, so the instrument discriminates.
